silhouette.reason: Barracks, a squad formed up at the gate, the tank parked on its path, the crystal deposit, a low perimeter wall, sandbags, crates and drums on one plate: reads as a faction compound from every view.
fixes: a gate gap with two posts in the perimeter wall so the path leads somewhere

proportions.reason: 30 x 25 x 11.2 m; every asset at true scale through ctx.use, soldiers fit the 3.5 m gate, tank on a lane wide enough for it.
fixes: widen the tank lane ~1 m so the track ruts do not touch the curb

materials.reason: Paving reads as stone flags, gravel paths contrast in value and roughness, the sub-assets keep their materials. The paving is flat with little tone variation and the wall caps are the same beige as the paving.
fixes: per-flag value jitter on the paving
darker coping stone on the perimeter wall

detail.reason: Crates, fuel drums, sandbag lines, track ruts, perimeter wall; the composed assets carry their own detail. The open plate areas between them are still empty.
fixes: a weapons rack or a signpost by the gate
a puddle and a drain grate on the paving

wear.reason: Track ruts on the tank lane, trampled darker gravel at the gate, the sub-assets weathered; the paving itself is clean.
fixes: grime() dirt along the wall foot and oil stains under the tank

lod.reason: lods.png: LOD2 (3.95k) keeps every asset, colour block, the paths, wall and props; the tank and soldiers simplify but hold outline and team red.

technical.reason: QA PASS: 144k / 34.1k / 3.95k tris, 36 / 36 / 22 draws. Fine as a showcase, but 36 draws for one placed asset is heavy and was not reduced.
